title: af/task-report@1
description: What `af task report --json` prints (ADR-0142): what recorded Tasks cost and how they ran, read from one Store and never estimated. A figure the Store does not record is absent, never zero or null. Tasks appear in the order the command named them, each numbered by its position (its round), and `pipelines` lists the distinct pipelines their current plans run, in first-use order. A Worker is named only by Provider kind, model and effort: every object is closed, so no Provider registry label or principal, path, credential, prompt or Worker output can appear. Totals are the sums of the Tasks' figures; a sum is absent when any Task does not record its part.

pipelines.description: Each distinct pipeline the Tasks' current plans run, in the order a Task first names it. Two entries share a `name@version` only when the Tasks' plans bind it differently.

model.description: A model identity, copied only when it is one. An allow-list: 1 to 96 characters from `A-Z a-z 0-9 ._:+-` plus at most one `/`; the first character and the first character after the `/` alphanumeric; no `..`; no `:` directly before the `/` (so no `://`); no drive-letter prefix such as `C:`; and neither side of the `/` a home, auth or state directory name (`home`, `users`, `root`, `tmp`, `var`, `private`, `state`, `auth`, `auth.*`, in any case). Any other recorded value may be a path, a URL or an account (an email address has an `@`) and is reported as `unknown`.

steps.description: Every node of the plan's compiled graph that runs a Worker, and every check node (the gate), in dependency order. Kernel bookkeeping nodes and Provider admission are left out.

stage.description: The step's position in dependency order, from 1; steps of one stage run in parallel.

role.description: The Worker slot's role (`implement`, `review`, `evaluate`, ...), or `gate` for a check node.

nodes.description: The qualified nodes of the step, in compiled order: nodes of one stage, role, Worker and check list form one step.

worker.description: The Worker the plan binds the step's slot to. Absent for a gate.

checks.description: A gate's checks, local and remote, in name order; empty for a Worker step.

findings.description: What the Task's review recorded. Absent for a Task whose plan has no review and for a collected Task.

blocker.description: Findings by severity, each counted once: the entries of the `FindingSet@1` each recorded review round's reduce step wrote whose `last_seen_round` is that round, a finding seen in several rounds of the Task counted once. The three counts are present together, or absent together when they are unknown: the review ran but a round it recorded has no complete `FindingSet@1` (a required reviewer's result is missing, say), or it recorded no round yet.

review_ran.description: A reviewer Attempt began, or a recorded round wrote its findings or admitted a reviewer's result.

gate_failed.description: A check the Task recorded failed and the review did not run.

failed_reviewers.description: Reviewer nodes with at least one failed Attempt.

round.description: The Task's 1-based position in the report: its row of the round table.

pipeline.description: The current plan's root Pipeline as `name@version`. Absent before a plan exists and for a collected Task.

outcome.description: The outcome `af task show` states: the result's domain conclusion (`pass`, `changes_requested`, `incomplete`, ...), or for an unfinished Task its phase (`planned`, `needs-plan-review`, ...).

collected.description: The Task was collected by `af task gc --apply` (ADR-0135): only its retained summary and its event times remain, so it carries neither `attempts` nor `nodes`.

review_rounds.description: Every Review Round the Task published, read from its log, so a round published before `af task refresh` cleared the execution outputs still counts. Absent for a collected Task.

runs.description: Writer leases in which an Attempt of the Task started: `af task start --execute` and every `af task run` that resumed it with new work. A lease that only settled or released an earlier writer's Attempts, as `af task refresh` does, or only published already selected results and finished the Task, is not a run.

wall_ms.description: From the Task's first to its last recorded event; a collection tombstone is not the Task's event.

active_ms.description: The sum of the runs' spans, each from its first to its last event: time spent waiting between runs, and a lease that started no Attempt, is not counted. Never above `wall_ms`.

nodes.description: Every node that began an Attempt, in the order its first Attempt began: one entry per node and Worker binding, so a node whose Attempts ran under plans that bound it to different Workers (after `af task refresh`) has one entry per Worker, each with its own Attempts and tokens.

total.description: Attempts begun, as `af task show` counts them.

failed_tokens.description: Tokens charged to the failed Attempts.

failures.description: The failed Attempts by reason class, in class order.

class.description: The failed Attempt's typed retry feedback code; `abandoned` for an Attempt recovery settled; `unclassified` for a failure that recorded no feedback.

role.description: The Worker slot's role, or the kernel operation of a node without a Worker (`check`, `seal`, `provider_admission`, ...).

worker.description: The Worker the node's slot was bound to in the plans of this entry's Attempts. Absent for a kernel node.

elapsed_ms.description: The node's Attempts' elapsed time, from their attempt walls or their start and settlement records. Absent unless every Attempt recorded it.

checks.description: Every check result the node's Attempts published, in Attempt order.

elapsed_ms.description: The check's recorded span; absent when it never started or recorded none.
